Check.description:
One thing that must hold for each entry the rule is about.

has, lacks, at_most, at_least: how many facts like ``pattern`` it has.
between: every value of ``pattern`` is a number from ``low`` to ``high``.
implies: if it has ``if_has``, it must also have ``pattern``.
not_both: it cannot have both ``pattern`` and ``not_with``.
believes, does_not_believe: it holds (or holds no) belief like ``pattern``,
about ``about_id`` or, when that is empty, about itself.

about_id.description: For believes: the entry the belief is about; empty means the entry itself
about_id.title: About Id

high.description: For between: the largest value allowed
high.title: High

if_has.description: For implies: the fact that, when present, requires pattern

low.description: For between: the smallest value allowed
low.title: Low

not_with.description: For not_both: the fact that cannot stand with pattern

Check.title: Check
